how.label: how sharing works
how.reviewed: Reviewed first. A person at FolderSkin looks at every pack. Nothing is public until it's approved.
how.public: Public once approved. The pictures, the pack's name and tags, and your name go to everyone under the licence you chose, and a licence can't be taken back from copies people already have.
how.noAccount: No account. The service keeps this computer's key and your name. Your network address is only ever kept scrambled.
how.withdraw: Yours to withdraw. Your submissions shows where each pack is, says why if one is turned down, and takes one back.

terms.yours: The pictures are yours, or CC0 and you've checked. Not taken from anywhere.
terms.nothingHarmful: Nothing sexual, hateful, gory, or about self-harm. Nothing involving a child.
terms.nobodyElse: Nobody else's logo, characters or likeness without their say-so.
terms.maintainer: A maintainer can decline a pack, or remove it later.
terms.agree: I've read the pack terms and this pack follows them.
